Job Title: Senior Big Data Engineer
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Hybrid: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Python
- Apache Spark
- Snowflake
Good to have:
- Apache Kafka
- Apache Airflow

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and optimise large-scale data processing pipelines using Python and Apache Spark, ensuring high throughput and low latency.
- Develop and maintain Snowflake data models, schemas, and ETL/ELT processes; implement best practices for data partitioning, clustering and cost control.
- Collaborate with data architects and product teams to translate business requirements into robust, scalable data solutions.
- Implement data quality checks, observability and alerting to ensure reliable downstream consumption.
- Troubleshoot performance issues across the data stack and propose architectural improvements.
- Contribute to data governance, security and compliance efforts, including access controls and sensitive data handling.
- Mentor mid-level engineers, conduct code reviews, and establish engineering standards and reusable components.
- Participate in sprint planning, design discussions and cross-functional knowledge sharing.
Preferred additions:
- Experience integrating real-time streaming sources using Apache Kafka and orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow to support near-real-time analytics.
